evidence_kind: CMOS5L post-route extraction and STA, not silicon
source_state: RTL at source_commit; the baseline and CTS-size-8 flow inputs are committed at 66964bb. The new CTS-size-4 and electrical-trial inputs and this updated result are uncommitted, with hashes below, pending maintainer review

candidate.io_contract: Provisional LibreLane base.sdc delay using IO_DELAY_CONSTRAINT=16%; not an external pad contract

flow.signoff_command: python3 tools/tt_axpe_flow.py run --tag pe10-25ns-signoff --resume-from-tag pe10-25ns --from OpenROAD.IRDropReport --full

post_route.stage: RC-extracted STA after detailed routing; full GDS/DRC/LVS is a separate continuation
post_route.worst_setup_path: uio_in[4] to instruction read-data register _16964_/D; 4 ns input delay included
post_route.fanout_root_cause: 160 of 162 violating drivers are CTS leaf clock buffers, typically driving 14-18 sinks against a limit of 8; the other two are fanout buffers. The separate CTS-size-8 trial below tests this diagnosis
post_route.slew_gap: 14 violating pins at the slow corner; worst slew 3.344 ns versus a 2.507 ns limit

baseline_gds_continuation.command: python3 tools/tt_axpe_flow.py run --tag pe10-25ns-signoff --resume-from-tag pe10-25ns --from OpenROAD.IRDropReport --full
baseline_gds_continuation.setup_and_hold: pass at all three corners, as in the post-route report
baseline_gds_continuation.electrical_limit: The resumed baseline still has 14 slow-corner max-slew and 162 max-fanout violations; clean DRC/LVS does not close them

cts8_trial.command: python3 tools/tt_axpe_flow.py run --profile configs/tt-axpe-6x4-25ns-cts8.json --flow-lock asic/axpe/flow-lock-25ns-cts8.json --workdir build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns-cts8 --tag pe10-25ns-cts8 --initial-state build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns/runs/pe10-25ns/34-openroad-detailedplacement/state_out.json --from OpenROAD.CTS
cts8_trial.diagnosis: The 160 clock-leaf fanout violations disappear; six data-path drivers still exceed fanout 8, and three gate arcs still exceed 2.507 ns slew at the slow corner
cts8_trial.scope: Post-route RC and STA only; this CTS variant has not completed GDS/DRC/LVS

cts4_stopped_trial.command: python3 tools/tt_axpe_flow.py run --profile configs/tt-axpe-6x4-25ns-cts4.json --flow-lock asic/axpe/flow-lock-25ns-cts4.json --workdir build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns-cts4 --tag pe10-25ns-cts4 --initial-state build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns/runs/pe10-25ns/34-openroad-detailedplacement/state_out.json --from OpenROAD.CTS
cts4_stopped_trial.stop_point: During OpenROAD detailed routing; no post-route metrics or GDS exist
cts4_stopped_trial.reason: At comparable mid-PNR STA the size-4 tree had 13 max-fanout violations versus two for the size-8 tree; the experiment was stopped to prioritize data-path electrical repair
cts4_stopped_trial.result: inconclusive for post-route timing; no pass claimed

electric_stopped_trial.command: python3 tools/tt_axpe_flow.py run --profile configs/tt-axpe-6x4-25ns-electric.json --flow-lock asic/axpe/flow-lock-25ns-electric.json --workdir build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns-electric --tag pe10-25ns-electric
electric_stopped_trial.diagnosis: At the post-global-route pre-detailed-route checkpoint, eight upstream CTS buffers each drive 16 sinks against the tightened limit of six. The same limit also reports six other drivers. This global constraint cannot clear the clock tree as configured.
electric_stopped_trial.stop_point: During OpenROAD detailed routing; no post-route metrics or GDS exist
electric_stopped_trial.result: The globally tightened fanout constraint is refuted for this CTS tree; post-route timing is unmeasured and no pass is claimed

verification.command: python3 tools/tt_axpe.py check --profile configs/tt-axpe-6x4-25ns.json --flow-lock asic/axpe/flow-lock-25ns.json --output build/asic/tt-axpe-25ns-export-check

verification.result: pass, including both new trial profiles
expected failure: max fanout disagrees with flow lock

outcome: The baseline 25 ns GDS continuation passes Magic DRC, LVS and antenna checks and keeps setup/hold clear. Electrical closure fails. CTS clustering at eight reduces fanout violations from 162 to six and slow-corner slew violations from 14 to six, with positive setup/hold slack.
next: Repair the six remaining data-path fanout violations and six slow-corner slew violations with a selective net or cell strategy that does not tighten the CTS fanout limit, then repeat full GDS/DRC/LVS and timing on the final architecture and validate the I/O delay against an external pad contract.
